title: [SPOILER] Road To Perdition - aunt Sara's death

commenti.body:
There's no way she's not dead.

Maguire overhears the conversation she has with Michael Sr. on the phone at Annie and Peter's memorial service. He figures out that once Rooney and Conner are out of the way that's the only place they can or would go so he sets up an ambush.

He wouldn't leave a loose end like Sara dangling and he doesn't have the finesse to send her away or divert her from her house considering he doesn't know exactly when the Sullivans are coming. Besides which he's a ruthless killer.

My guess is as soon as he recuperated sufficiently from the blast of shattered lightbulb in his face, he made his way to Perdition, killed Sara pretty quickly, disposed of her body somehow, and waited.
It makes sense, you are interpreting so many elements as I did, that's what bother me. But why not, if we do not have any clues.
